mapper.update: UPDATE memories SET category = #{category}, memory_text = #{memoryText}, strength = #{strength}, archived = #{archived}, embedding_json = #{embeddingJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memories WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
